messages:
maria (marketing): Team quick sync  final draft for Redwood Optimize post is ready. Can we lock publish time, hero quote, and lead routing?

alexa (growth): Prefer Tue 9:00 PT so sales has Monday morning to prep. Also want an influencer preview 48h prior.

rishi (product): Tuesday works. Confirm benchmarks to cite: ~36% lower unit cost and 2.3x median latency improvement. Need methodology link in footnote.

taylor (growthops): Draft HubSpot routing: blog -> list: launch_optimize_2026; webinar reg -> tag: webinar_early; CTA clicks -> workflow: nurture_optimize. I'll append utm_campaign=optimize_launch.

kate (legal): Quick legal notes: avoid absolutes. Add footnote: "Benchmarks run on Redwood eval-suite; representative workloads only. Methodology: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/optimize-2026" Also confirm partner quote approvals.

sam (design): Uploaded OG image v7 (1200x630). Need final hero quote (max 70 chars) and alt text confirmation.

maria (marketing): Hero candidates: A) "Reduce inference cost by 36% with Redwood Optimize" B) "2.3x faster median latency in our benchmark" Which to A/B?

alexa (growth): A/B both headline and CTA. HeadlineA=cost, HeadlineB=latency. CTAA="Register for webinar", CTAB="Read the benchmark". Track via `?utm_experiment=headlineA` etc.

taylor (growthops): I'll configure HubSpot experiment and map `webinar_early` -> SDR queue `optimize_sdr`. Also set form fields: name, work email, company, role, use case, consent.

rishi (product): Landing page ready for copy insertion. I'll add a short FAQ section answering perf and quantization questions.

kate (legal): Approved BetaCustomer quote if we include line "Used with permission" and link Doc #9864. No other edits.

publish-bot: Assets checklist: og:image present, hero quote missing, alt text present, testimonial file missing. Run `/schedule publish 2026-05-12T16:00Z` after checklist complete.

maria (marketing): Draft hero quote (64 chars): "Optimize inference: faster responses, lower unit cost." I'll tighten it to 60 chars.

sam (design): Alt text set to "chart showing latency and cost before vs after Optimize". Please confirm hero quote length once updated.

alexa (growth): For email subject test: subjA="Reduce inference costs 36% with Redwood Optimize" subjB="See 2.3x faster LLM responses in our benchmark". Add `?utm_experiment=subjA` to variant A.

taylor (growthops): Also recommend adding `utm_partner=influencer` for influencer preview links and a password-protected preview URL. I'll set embargo meta header on preview.

rishi (product): Webinar scheduled for Jun 2 10:00 PT. I'll add the calendar block and registration widget.

kate (legal): Confirm NDA not required for standard influencer preview, but include partner terms link. :thumbsup:

maria (marketing): Final checklist for EOD Fri: 1) hero quote locked 2) testimonial file attached 3) HubSpot routing validated 4) subject/headline experiments configured 5) embargo preview set. Please react :thumbsup: if green.

alexa (growth): :thumbsup:
taylor (growthops): :thumbsup: will validate routing in staging.
sam (design): :thumbsup: hero quote candidates in Drive.
rishi (product): :thumbsup: landing page live in staging.
kate (legal): :thumbsup: legal doc attached.
maria (marketing): Great  locking publish Tue 2026-05-12 09:00 PT if no objections. I'll run `/schedule publish 2026-05-12T16:00Z` once the missing testimonial file is attached. Thanks!
